abyssal-ink.$description: Abyssal Ink — Page canvas and hero backgrounds — near-black with a green undertone makes the mint accent glow rather than fight

forest-floor.$description: Forest Floor — Card and elevated surface — one step up from canvas, reads as a panel cut from the same dark material

deep-canopy.$description: Deep Canopy — Secondary card surface and nav backgrounds — provides a second elevation step above Forest Floor

midnight-tinge.$description: Midnight Tinge — Sectional backgrounds where a cooler, blue-tinted dark is needed for variation

moss-border.$description: Moss Border — List dividers and inset borders on dark surfaces — green-tinted so dividers feel atmospheric, not structural

iron-veil.$description: Iron Veil — Hairline borders and card outlines — the most-used divider color, bridges green and neutral tones

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ghost-white.$description: Ghost White — Secondary surface highlights, subtle borders, and inactive iconography on light or dark contexts

ash-label.$description: Ash Label — Muted helper text, footer metadata, and secondary nav labels

slate-caption.$description: Slate Caption — Tertiary text and inactive state captions

sea-mist.$description: Sea Mist — Body text in teal-tinted sections and secondary paragraph copy

tide-pool.$description: Tide Pool — Muted body copy and link text where a subtle green-gray harmonizes with the brand hue

mint-signal.$description: Mint Signal — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

cyan-pulse.$description: Cyan Pulse — Secondary accent for gradient washes, decorative icons, and teal-tinted emphasis text

aurora-gradient.$description: Aurora Gradient — Decorative gradient that sweeps from mint to violet, used in feature highlights and brand flourishes

twilight-wash.$description: Twilight Wash — Decorative surface gradient — dark teal to deeper teal for atmospheric panels and section backgrounds

neuehaasgrotesk.$description: Primary typeface for all display, heading, and body text. Weight 330 at 70-96px is the signature choice: most brands shout at 700+, Shopify whispers at 330 with generous letter-spacing (0.015-0.04em), creating authority through restraint. The

inter-variable.$description: Secondary typeface for nav, buttons, footer, and micro-copy where Inter's narrower proportions and tighter letter-spacing (0.06em uppercase) suit compact UI contexts
